findings.summary: AC-dm-42 is checked only against rows seeded through Prisma; the PRD wording 'depois de uma conclusão real pela API' (a company created and a diagnosis completed through the API, then the summary read) is not exercised because companyRoutes and diagnosisRoutes are not mounted in this wave. Deferred to integration, which must add the API-driven case once those routes exist.

Real SIGTERM/SIGINT delivery to the backend process was not run by QA (win32 does not deliver POSIX signals via kill). The implementer's evidence is an in-process SIGINT with an open keep-alive connection, which QA did not re-run; the shutdown path on macOS/Linux is unverified. QA also did not re-run the ad-hoc boot of server/main.ts.

Capability-wide checks outside this unit's Done-when were not run by QA: `node scripts/smoke-boot.mjs`, `pnpm build`, `pnpm test:e2e`, `node scripts/smoke-store-package.mjs` and the Play dev-link. They depend on sibling units and the integrated app, so they belong to integration (see messages[]).

FitPulseSqliteAdapterFactory.connect() (lines 16-18) calls super.connect() and then adapter.executeScript(CONNECTION_PRAGMAS) with no try/finally, so a PRAGMA failure (e.g. 'file is not a database') leaves the SQLite handle open; on win32 the file stays locked until exit. Confirmed by reading the code; not reproduced by QA. Owned by phase-1-backend-db; not edited here. The new test removes its temp folders best-effort, so this does not fail the unit.

messages.text: AC-dm-42 end-to-end (deferred from this unit): once companyRoutes and diagnosisRoutes are mounted in server/app.ts, add a case to tests/api/playRoutes.test.ts (or the diagnosis test) that creates a company and completes a diagnosis through the API, then calls GET /api/assistant/summary and repeats the exact-fields, no-money and no-answers assertions. Also check that the summary's lockingDimension (display name) matches the product wording.

The Done-when command `pnpm test -- tests/api/playRoutes.test.ts` runs the whole suite: pnpm forwards `--`, so vitest receives `-- tests/api/playRoutes.test.ts` and runs every test file (7 files, 395 tests, exit 0 in this run). The unit's own file alone is `npx vitest run tests/api/playRoutes.test.ts` (48 tests, exit 0). The Done-when result therefore depends on sibling test files passing.

Remaining CAP-dm-play-runtime checks to run after integration, all not run by QA: (1) `node scripts/smoke-boot.mjs` (loopback-only listen on both ports; the Vite proxy must not rewrite Host to anything other than 127.0.0.1 or localhost, because the guard checks only the hostname); (2) `pnpm build`; (3) `pnpm test:e2e`; (4) `node scripts/smoke-store-package.mjs`; (5) dev-link in the Play with the webview badge green. On win32 a connection to a non-loopback IPv4 times out instead of being refused, so 'never connected' is the pass criterion for LAN probes.

server/db/prismaClient.ts connect(): if adapter.executeScript(CONNECTION_PRAGMAS) throws after super.connect() succeeded, the adapter is never disposed. Wrap the PRAGMA step so the adapter is closed on failure and the error rethrown. Not edited by phase-1-backend-http.
